channel.title: Seoulmate · Korea travel guides
channel.description: Plan a Korea trip around food, K-pop, history and local life, with practical city guides for foreign travelers.

item.title: Gwangmyeong Cave with Kids: A Half-Day Plan and Stroller Tips
item.description: Visiting Gwangmyeong Cave near Seoul with children? Admission, cave temperature, stroller advice, parking and a gentle half-day plan for a cold or rainy day.

item.title: Gapyeong Date: Nami Island Walk and Garden of Morning Calm Winter Lights
item.description: A day-to-night Gapyeong date from Seoul: Nami Island's tree-lined paths by ferry, a sunset drive, then the Garden of Morning Calm winter light festival. Tips and timing inside.

item.title: Sokcho Date: Ferris Wheel Sunset and Expo Tower Night View by the Winter Sea
item.description: A winter Sokcho date from day to night: Yeonggeumjeong pavilion, the hand-pulled Abai ferry, Sokcho Eye Ferris wheel at sunset and Expo Tower views over Cheongcho Lake.

item.title: Andong Date: Hahoe Village by Day, Buyongdae at Sunset, Woryeonggyo Bridge at Night
item.description: A quiet late-autumn date in Andong: stroll UNESCO-listed Hahoe Village, watch sunset from Buyongdae cliff, then walk the lit wooden Woryeonggyo Bridge after dinner.

item.title: Yongin with Kids: Everland at Christmas or the Korean Folk Village (Pick One)
item.description: Late November with kids near Seoul: Everland's Christmas season or the Korean Folk Village after Halloween ends. Ages, prices, parking and an easy one-day plan.

item.title: Sejong with Kids: National Children's Museum and the Arboretum Greenhouses
item.description: A weather-proof family day in Sejong: the hands-on National Children's Museum (book 30 days ahead), warm greenhouses at Sejong National Arboretum and a picnic zone.

item.title: Gyeongju Date: Hwangridan-gil by Day, Woljeonggyo at Sunset, Donggung Palace at Night
item.description: A late-November Gyeongju date from day to night: hanok cafés on Hwangridan-gil, sunset at Woljeonggyo Bridge and the famous reflections of Donggung Palace and Wolji Pond.

item.title: Gunsan Date: Retro Old Town, Railway Village, Sea Sunset and Eunpa Lake Lights
item.description: A retro day-to-night date in Gunsan: 1930s-era streets and a 4-museum pass, Gyeongam-dong railway village, a Seonyudo sunset and the lit Mulbit Bridge at Eunpa Lake.

item.title: Asan with Kids: Hot Spring Water Park, Oeam Folk Village and Hyeonchungsa
item.description: A 2-day winter family trip to Asan: the Spavis hot spring water park, the stone walls of Oeam Folk Village and free Hyeonchungsa shrine, with changing-room rules to know.

item.title: Yeosu with Kids: Aqua Planet, the Sea Cable Car & Odongdo Island in 2 Days
item.description: A relaxed 2-day Yeosu family plan: Aqua Planet aquarium, the sea cable car, the Odongdo camellia train, rainy-day backups and crab rice set meals near the station.

item.title: Yeosu Night Sea Date: Sunset Cable Car, Night Cruise & Romantic Pocha Street
item.description: A November Yeosu date from afternoon to night: the Angel Mural Village, sea-view cafes, a sunset ride on the sea cable car, night cruises and the Nangman Pocha street.

item.title: Pohang Date: Space Walk Sunset, Yeongildae Night View & Gwamegi Season
item.description: A free-entry Pohang date for November: gwamegi tasting in Guryongpo, sunset on the Space Walk sculpture, Yeongildae pavilion lights and a new late-night observatory.

item.title: Pocheon with Kids: Art Valley Lake, a Free Astronomy Museum & Herb Island Lights
item.description: A day-to-night family trip from Seoul to Pocheon: an emerald quarry lake with a monorail, a free astronomy museum and the Herb Island garden of lights after dark.

item.title: Paju with Kids: Jangdan Bean Festival, Majang Lake Bridge & a Free Museum
item.description: An easy family day trip from Seoul to Paju: the Jangdan Bean Festival (Nov 27–29), the Imjingak peace gondola, Majang Lake suspension bridge, a free museum and tofu.

item.title: Incheon Day Date: Open Port Streets, Wolmido Sunset & Free Songdo Night View
item.description: A subway day date from Seoul to Incheon: Chinatown and the old Open Port streets, a heritage cafe, Wolmido sunset and the free G-Tower observatory over Songdo.

item.title: Gangneung Date: Anmok Coffee Street, Gangmun Beach & Sotdae Bridge at Night
item.description: A Gangneung date from day to night: sea-view coffee on Anmok Coffee Street, Gangmun Beach photo spots, the lit Sotdae Bridge, Chodang tofu and a pine forest art show.

item.title: Danyang with Kids: Freshwater Aquarium, River Skywalk & Garlic Market Snacks
item.description: A half-day Danyang family plan that works rain or shine: the Danuri freshwater aquarium, Mancheonha Skywalk above the river and garlic snacks at Gugyeong Market.

item.title: Daegu with Kids: 5 Easy Stops from the Science Museum to a Free Arboretum
item.description: A Daegu family day for November: the National Science Museum, an aquarium at Dongdaegu Station, a free children's museum, the arboretum and Apsan cable car views.

item.title: Chuncheon with Kids: Animation & Robot Museum, Soyang River Skywalk and Dakgalbi
item.description: A Chuncheon family day from Seoul: the Animation Museum and Toy Robot Hall, a glass-floored skywalk over the river, dakgalbi for lunch and notes on LEGOLAND in winter.

item.title: Tongyeong Date: Cable Car Views, Harbor Sunset & DIPIRANG Night Light Walk
item.description: A day-to-night Tongyeong date: the Mireuksan cable car over the islands, Dongpirang murals, honey bread, a harbor sunset and the DIPIRANG night light trail.

item.title: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress with Kids: Hwaseong Tour Train, Royal Palace & Half-Day Plan
item.description: Suwon Hwaseong with kids: ride the little tour train around the UNESCO fortress, explore Hwaseong Haenggung palace, rainy-day museums and a half-day plan.

item.title: Suncheon Bay with Kids in November: Golden Reed Fields, National Garden Children's Zoo & Eco Boat
item.description: Suncheon Bay with kids in November: boardwalks through golden reeds, crabs on the mudflats, the National Garden's children's zoo, the SkyCube and an eco boat.

item.title: Suncheon Bay Sunset Date: Golden Reeds, Yongsan Observatory Timing & Cockle Dinner
item.description: Time your Suncheon Bay date right: a garden walk, golden reed boardwalks, sunset over the S-shaped channel from Yongsan Observatory, then a cockle dinner.

item.title: Skiing in Korea 2026–27: Best Ski Resorts Near Seoul, Opening Dates & How to Get There
item.description: Planning a ski trip to Korea for winter 2026–27? The main resorts near Seoul and Pyeongchang, when the season opens, how to get there and tips for visitors.

item.title: Seoul Grand Park & Gwacheon Science Museum with Kids: One-Day Plan (Last Year of the Sky Lift)
item.description: A family day in Gwacheon, one subway line from central Seoul: Seoul Grand Park zoo, the sky lift in its final year, the National Science Museum and lunch.

item.title: Seoul Date Night in November: Deoksugung, a Free Night-View Deck & Namsan Sunset
item.description: A budget date night in Seoul: Deoksugung Palace for 1,000 won, Jeongdong-gil, the free Jeongdong Observatory overlooking the palace, and Namsan at sunset.

item.title: National Museum of Korea Children's Museum: Free Booking Guide & Half-Day Plan in Seoul
item.description: The National Museum of Korea's free Children's Museum in Seoul: which ages it suits, how to book 80-minute sessions, parking, lunch and a half-day plan.

item.title: How to Watch a KBO Baseball Game in Korea: Tickets, Cheering & Stadium Food (Foreigner's Guide)
item.description: Watching KBO baseball in Korea: season dates, which stadium to pick, how foreigners can buy tickets, the cheering culture and what to eat at the ballpark.

item.title: Jeonju with Kids: 5 Family-Friendly Spots in November (Free Museum, Zoo & Rainy-Day Options)
item.description: Visiting Jeonju with kids? A free children's museum, a 1,000-won zoo, stroller tips for the Hanok Village, a rainy-day backup and a kid-friendly lunch.

item.title: Jeonju Date Itinerary: Hanok Alleys, Sunset at Cheongyeonru & Night Views (November)
item.description: A romantic Jeonju day for couples: hanok alleys and hanbok, sunset at Cheongyeonru pavilion, Omokdae's night view, Gyeonggijeon night programs and late bites.
